The top medical device companies in Australia include homegrown global innovators like Cochlear and ResMed, alongside major international providers with large Australian footprints such as Johnson & Johnson Medical, Medtronic, and Stryker. [](https://www.mordorintelligence.com/industry-reports/australia-general-surgical-devices-market/companies)

- **Cochlear:** World leader in implantable hearing solutions, headquartered in Sydney.

- **ResMed:** Global pioneer in cloud-connectable sleep apnea and respiratory care devices.

- **PolyNovo:** Developer of novel dermal regeneration solutions (Novosorb) for surgical and trauma wounds.

- **Telix Pharmaceuticals:** Specialist in targeted radiopharmaceuticals and diagnostic imaging devices

- **SomnoMed:** Provider of oral appliance therapy for sleep-related breathing disorders. [](https://www.mordorintelligence.com/industry-reports/australia-cardiovascular-devices-market/companies)

### Major Global Players in Australia

- **Johnson & Johnson Medical:** Leading supplier of surgical tech, orthopedics, and general medical devices.

- **Medtronic:** Major provider of cardiovascular, neurological, and surgical medical technology.

- **Stryker:** Prominent orthopedic and medical equipment supplier.

- **Baxter Healthcare:** Major manufacturer of hospital and renal medical equipment.

- **GE HealthCare / Philips:** Leading diagnostic imaging and patient monitoring technology providers. [](https://www.mordorintelligence.com/industry-reports/australia-cardiovascular-devices-market/companies)
